data.summary: This one‑week plan focuses on intensive review of all AP Chemistry units, with a mix of practice problems, concept checks, and timed practice to build confidence before the exam.

tasks: Do 20 timed practice problems covering all units, marking each answer against the scoring guide.
Review key formulas and concept maps for each unit, writing a one‑sentence summary for each topic.
Complete a full-length AP Chemistry practice test under timed conditions, then analyze errors and adjust study focus accordingly.

data.final_week_advice: Use the remaining time to solidify weak areas identified during the practice test, focusing on problem‑solving speed and conceptual clarity before the exam.
